contest.measure_text: Carson City Government Accountability, Charter Update, No Tax Increase Measure. Shall the measure amending the Carson City Charter to require campaign contribution transparency; make the City Charter consistent with State law on referring ballot measures for voter approval; update term limits to increase voter options; update City Treasurer duties; clarify and clean up inconsistent or outdated language, be adopted? Supporters: Lula Davis-Holmes, Mayor; Cedric Hicks, Mayor Pro Tem; Jawane Hilton, Councilmember; Arleen Rojas, Councilmember; Darrow's New Orleans Grill Opponents: None submitted.
